name: Sinpurged
body:
This androgynous, hairless humanoid is covered in so many scars, the fact that it yet lives is a small miracle. Its bones are twisted, its skin melted, and its eyes little more than empty pits.

Sinpurged	CR 2

XP 600
NG Medium aberration
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent evil; Perception +7

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural)
hp 19 (3d8+6)
Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +4
Immune mind-affecting effects; SR 13

Speed 40 ft.
Melee halberd +3 (1d10+1/×3)
Special Attacks gaze

Str 13, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 12
Base Atk +2; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative
Skills Intimidate +7, Perception +7, Stealth +7, Survival +7
Languages Celestial, Common
SQ martial proficiency

Environment any ruins
Organization solitary, pair, or convent (3–8)
Treasure standard (halberd, other treasure)

Gaze (Su) Nauseated by guilt for 1 round, 5 feet, Will DC 12 negates. This is a mind-affecting compulsion emotion effect to which good-aligned outsiders are immune. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Martial Proficiency (Ex) Sinpurged are proficient in all simple and martial weapons, armor, and shields (except tower shields).

Scent Evil (Su) Each sinpurged has scent against evil-aligned creatures.

Sinpurged are the twisted remnants of mortals who have been bodily plunged into the flames of purgatory, scorching away their sins. They were created in ancient times to serve in the armies of a zealous inquisition that cared more about victory than well-being of its volunteer soldiers.

Seven Types of Sinpurged

The above stats represent a sloth-purged, the most common type of this creature. Each type possesses unique ability modifiers, which are listed after their name.

Envy-Purged (+2 Cha, –2 Str): Short and thin, envy-purged often become bards. They are fond of telling stories about the exploits of others.

Gluttony-Purged (+2 Dex, –2 Con): Lean and quick, gluttony-purged often become rangers, living off the fruits of the land.

Greed-Purged (+2 Wis, –2 Dex): Short and stocky, greed-purged often become monks, preferring to rely more upon inherent ability than upon equipment.

Lust-Purged (+2 Int, –2 Cha): Noted for their innocent, cherubic faces, lust-purged often become wizards. They spend long periods of time in studying in solitude.

Pride-Purged (+4 Wis, –2 Int, –2 Cha): Pride-purged are tall but meek. They often become clerics, favoring spells that grant benefits to their allies.

Sloth-Purged: These sinpurged use the statistics given above. They often become inquisitors, relentlessly destroying evil wherever it rears its ugly head.

Wrath-Purged (+2 Wis, –2 Dex): These sinpurged are stoic and stout. They often become fighters, focusing more on defensive tactics than on pure offense.
